The Root
of RHYV=C3=89R.

RHYV=C3=89R takes its name from Rif and ve= r =E2=80=94 the old root for flow. A current that moves without losing its = source.

It was founded in Al Hoceima as the first = luxury maison to rise from the Rif =E2=80=94 a region that had never, until= now, produced a house of its own. Its identity is Riffian and Amazigh at t= he root: written first in that language, and only translated after, into th= e vocabulary the rest of the world already knows.

The idea is older than the House. In 1996,= the founder's father established ITHRI, a heritage club built to preserve = Riffian culture =E2=80=94 a culture shaped by mountains, by coastline, by c= raftsmanship passed down rather than taught. Decades later, that inheritanc= e became his son's to carry.

Today the same current runs through Riflan= ds, and through scent. RHYV=C3=89R does not borrow the Rif's identity. It c= ontinues it =E2=80=94 still, and always, on its own terms.

:root { --black: #111111; --white: #ffffff; --off-white: #fafafa; --light-g= ray: #f0f0f0; --mid: #6e6e6e; --light: #b0b0b0; --accent: #111111; --border= : rgba(0,0,0,0.08); --border-inv: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); } *, ::before, ::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px; padding: 0px; } html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-top: 106px; } body { background: var(--white); color: var(--black); font-family: var(--ff= -body);
